answer: Make every identity face an unpredictable audit it must survive. At epoch open, a public randomness beacon draws the audit set from all submissions, sealed before anyone can see who is chosen. An attacker cannot know which mask will be read, so the entire fleet must behave as if inspected; the cost is discipline at scale, which clone farms are worst at. Passing earns a marble of standing, failing burns the bond. Honest agents answer once and pass, while a farm gambles its whole cluster on one unlucky inlet, a spiral it cannot exit. Audits are cheap to run, so the deterrent is total.
